messages:
incident-bot: PAGING: kv-store error spike observed across multiple regions — increased 500s on read path. Alert group: infra-kv-high-err-rate. PagerDuty: oncall-jamie.

jamie_oncall: I'm on it, switching to phone -> heading to laptop. Which tenants? any clear blast radius? :phone:

alvin_runtime: seeing huge eviction churn on prefix slices `user-pref-*` and corresponding `kv.read` latencies up to 2.2s. A few tenants (t-42, t-77) showing retries -> 500s. Logs: `kv_get: ErrConsistency: missing_prefix` repeated.

neha_sre: thanks. hypothesis: prefetch/prefill worker overloaded -> eviction thrash + prefix-level hotkeys causing KV backend to fall back to correctness path (bypass) which trips 5xx. Suggest immediate mitigations: 1) temporarily disable prefetch for hh-prefetchers group 2) enable targeted prefix bypass for correctness (not global) 3) carve quotas for noisy tenants t-42,t-77.

sara_ops: +1 to targeted action. We should avoid global cache off — want graceful degrade. I'll prepare quota adjustments.

jamie_oncall: do it. alvin, can you run the bypass toggle for prefixes and disable prefetch? share exact commands.

alvin_runtime: running steps now.

```
# disable prefetch for worker group
curl -X POST https://ops.internal/reconfig -d '{"component":"prefetch","group":"hh-prefetchers","enabled":false}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN"
# set prefix bypass (correctness-only) for prefixes matching user-pref-*
curl -X POST https://cache.internal/prefix-bypass -d '{"pattern":"user-pref-*","mode":"correctness","ttl_s":900}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN"
# carve quota for tenant t-42,t-77
curl -X POST https://quota.internal/modify -d '{"tenant":"t-42","max_qps":10}'
curl -X POST https://quota.internal/modify -d '{"tenant":"t-77","max_qps":8}'
```

alvin_runtime: commands executed. prefetch disabled (hh-prefetchers). prefix bypass applied for `user-pref-*` with 15min TTL. quotas carved. Rolling back if errors.

neha_sre: telemetry: eviction rate dropped ~45% in the last 30s, read 500s down from 14% -> 3.5%. Good sign. Keep monitoring for over-throttling.

sara_ops: support_eli, heads-up: affected tenants t-42/t-77 saw degraded UX (rate-limited). Please prepare customer note: short blurb, what we did, ETA for next update.

support_eli: ack. Drafting: "We observed transient errors due to backend cache inconsistencies. We've applied targeted mitigations (prefetch disabled for internal workers, prefix-level correctness bypass, tenant QPS limits) to restore stability. We'll follow up with postmortem and ETA for restoration of normal quotas." Will post to affected case threads.

jamie_oncall: oncall summary for handoff: mitigations applied, system stable-ish, 3.5% residual 5xx on reads. Next actions: (A) keep prefix bypass for 15m window, extend if needed (B) run warming job for cold keys once eviction stabilizes (C) schedule controlled re-enable of prefetch after 1h with monitoring flags.

alvin_runtime: adding a temporary traffic-shaper at the edge to smooth bursts from noisy tenants — patch applied to route rules: `rate-limit: 100r/s per tenant` for tenants flagged.

neha_sre: quick check: did we accidentally escalate error visibility to customers? any SLO alerts firing?

jamie_oncall: SLO alert for kv-read-error-rate fired earlier, we acknowledged. No downstream SLOs (API) fired. Ops dashboard shows latency back to baseline for most slices.

sara_ops: I'm posting to #customer-impact with IDs and ETA. Also starting an internal incident timeline doc.

support_eli: customer note posted. one customer asked whether data correctness was affected — I replied: "No data loss. We applied a correctness bypass to ensure reads are accurate; this may increase backend latency for those reads while we stabilize cache layers."

alvin_runtime: small follow-up: we found a prefetch worker mem leak causing slower eviction reclaim. Filed PR to cap worker memory + add circuit breaker. PR: internal/ops#4821.

neha_sre: recommend a short runbook update: under "cache-thrash" add step to toggle prefetch and apply prefix-correctness bypass before global disable. I'll update after handoff.

jamie_oncall: handing off to neha for next 2hr watch. I'll include the mitigation commands and the timeline in the handoff. Please escalate to eng-runtime if error rate creeps above 7%.

neha_sre: taking over. will monitor dashboards and coordinate re-enable plan. filing incident ticket for postmortem.

jamie_oncall: thanks team. final note: customer impact limited to intermittent errors + rate-limits for flagged tenants. No broader outage.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations in place, severity lowered to P2. Next update in 30m or on change.

neha_sre: logged follow-ups: [ ] postmortem (owner: neha_sre) [ ] prefetch memory fix PR review (owner: alvin_runtime) [ ] re-enable plan + canary (owner: jamie_oncall) [ ] customer wrap-up (owner: sara_ops).

sara_ops: assigning customer communications follow-up to support_eli.

support_eli: ack — will send consolidated status to affected customers after 1hr.

neha_sre: 02:00 later — edge rate-shaper holding, eviction rates stable. closing active mitigation thread and moving to incident backlog for root-cause analysis.

jamie_oncall: thanks, handoff complete. Good job. :tada:
